0022600227.text: The 76ers (9-3) enter their 13th game of the season second in the East and second in the Atlantic, one game back, with a 7-3 mark over their last ten and a one-game losing streak, while the Raptors (5-6) are seventh in the East, fourth in the Atlantic and 4.5 games back, with a 4-6 mark over their last ten and a two-game losing streak. Philadelphia is missing Adem Bona (out, back sprain), Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery), Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), LeBron James (out, back) and Joel Embiid (day-to-day, foot, game-time decision), and Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard (out, knee inflammation), Nate Bittle (out, foot fracture), Scottie Barnes (out, groin soreness) and Trayce Jackson-Davis (out, illness). The teams split their 2025-26 series 2-2, with the 76ers winning the most recent meeting 115-102 in Toronto on January 12, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 season series.
